subject: Post-demo: LedgerAI security form path decision & clarifying asks
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@ledgerai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: LedgerAI security form path decision & clarifying asks

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Ask we heard: LedgerAI needs a security intake that confirms SOC 2 posture, HIPAA coverage (for PHI flows), and a vendor questionnaire for procurement.
- Decision point: you indicated Procurement prefers a CAIQ baseline but your security team will add ~12 custom questions around data residency and audit logging.

Could you confirm two quick items so we scope correctly: 
1) SOC 2: is LedgerAI expecting a completed SOC 2 Type II report, or will a SOC 2 Type I + roadmap be acceptable for initial procurement review? (procurement timeline will influence this)
2) Data residency: you mentioned EU customers — do you require production data to be resident in a specific region or just demonstrable controls for data residency?

Proposed Redwood next steps:
- I can send a prefilled CAIQ with our standard answers and a short SOC 2 summary (we have a SOC 2 summary PDF).
- Ben (security) will map evidence owners for anything you flag as needed.
- Rishi will send a mutual action plan (MAP) and proposed turnaround times.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 high-level), redwood-caiaq-prefill.csv (CSV prefill for CAIQ).

If you’d like, we can hold a short handoff call between LedgerAI security + Redwood security tomorrow or Wednesday. What time window works on your side?

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@ledgerai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@ledgerai.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: LedgerAI security form path decision & clarifying asks

Thanks Mina — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) SOC 2: procurement would prefer a SOC 2 Type II but we can accept a Type I + clear remediation timeline for the initial contract approval. Target: final Type II within 6–9 months post-contract.
2) Data residency: for now we need to demonstrate the ability to segment EU customer data to EU regions (not mandatory for all customers now, but a gating requirement for two pilots). We will surface exact regions in the handoff.

On questionnaires: security wants the CAIQ baseline + our custom 12 items. We use a secure intake folder (we'll share an SFTP/secure link) — but DocuSign is not ideal for this type of evidence. 

Procurement timeline: target signature by June 15. That gives ~6 weeks for security review if we start intake early next week. 

I’m looping in LedgerAI engineering/security but for now please send the prefilled CAIQ and SOC 2 summary. I’ve attached our internal dataflow diagram for context (ledgerai-dataflow.pdf).

Best,
Samantha
Director, Procurement & Security Programs
LedgerAI
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@ledgerai.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: LedgerAI security form path decision & clarifying asks

Samantha — thanks. Proposed MAP and timing below so procurement has predictable SLAs: 

- Wed 29 Apr: Redwood sends prefilled CAIQ + SOC 2 summary (Mina).
- Thu 30 Apr: Security handoff call (30 min) — Redwood security (Ben) + LedgerAI security to triage custom questions and dataflow gaps.
- Fri 1 May: LedgerAI returns completed CAIQ items that need evidence or follow-up (mark items that require PO/engineering).
- Mon 4 May: Ben shares evidence bundle or owners for items we can gather internally.
- Week of 11 May: Final clarifications; procurement & legal to review redlines.

Turnaround targets: we should budget 3–5 business days per evidence tranche. If that works, we can aim for your June 15 signature.

Ben — can you own the call and evidence mapping? Mina — I’ll publish the MAP in HubSpot and include the Drive folder link.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: LedgerAI security form path decision & clarifying asks

On Wed, Apr 29, 2026 at 9:22 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben — can you own the call and evidence mapping? Mina — I’ll publish the MAP in HubSpot and include the Drive folder link.

Happy to own it. Proposed agenda for Thu 30 Apr (30 min):
- 0–5m: Introductions & objectives (confirm SOC 2 expectation vs Type I interim)
- 5–15m: Walk LedgerAI dataflow (we have ledgerai-dataflow.pdf) and call out PHI touchpoints
- 15–25m: Triage LedgerAI custom 12 questions — classify as: 
   * Evidence we can provide immediately (policies, configs)
   * Requires engineering change / timeline
   * Governance/legal asks (contracts, DPA)
- 25–30m: Assign owners + next steps and expected dates

Prep items for LedgerAI: the CAIQ prefill and SOC 2 summary from Mina. Also please upload any network/dataflow diagrams and indicate which customers need EU residency.

I’ll join from the security team and collect evidence — attach stubs I’ll expect: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-caiaq-prefill.csv.

-Ben

--
Ben Carter
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
